notes.title: Torn Veil Release hot fix
notes.content:
Huge thank you for those who downloaded and played the game!

With the release going forward I will read and try to fix and improve the game.


 Fixed ending Dialogue triggering twice.
 Fixed mouse sensitivity not being applied properly.
 Fixed garage letter and widget mismatch.


These bugs are fixed now and many smaller ones. If you encounter bugs you may talk about it in the discussion of the game as I am actively reading them. 

Thank you all again.

-KenshiDev

notes.title: Torn Veil is out! - PLAY NOW with 3 available endings
notes.content:
The veil has been torn… and there's no going back.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491595/5e937d2f532bda2fef06ba56979e9e80c6e599c8.png"]
After months of development, fear, and mystery — Torn Veil is officially live on Steam.

🕯️ Enter a twisted house where souls are tested, memories are fractured, and nothing stays dead for long.
Explore a haunting house that seems to remember you. Uncover what happened to the scientists behind the soul experiment, and survive the presence that lurks behind every corner.

🔪 Features
– A story-driven psychological horror experience
– Puzzles, hidden lore, and twisted AI entities
– Arabic and English support
– Designed by a solo Iraqi developer

Thank you to everyone who supported, wishlisted, tested, or even just cheered silently from the shadows.
Now it’s your turn to uncover the truth beneath the veil.

Play it. Survive it. Remember it.
— KenshiDev
